question: AR Rahman won the Grammy Awards for which movie?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Slumdog Millionaire.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian music director **A R Rahman **achieved two trophies at the **52nd Grammy Awards for his music in** **'Slumdog Millionaire'.**
 
• The main aim of Slumdog Millionaire **t****hose born poor tend to remain less well-off, regardless of how smart or hardworking they might be**. 
 
• AR Rahman has achieved two Grammy Awards in 2010 - Best Collection Soundtrack for a Motion Picture **(for Slumdog Millionaire) and Best Motion Picture Song (for Jai Ho).**
 
• A **Grammy Award** is any of a series of awards presented annually in the United States by either the National Academy of **Recording Arts & Sciences or the Latin Academy of Recording Arts & Sciences.​** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Roja **was a Tamil film that achieved acclaim from throughout the world. 
 
• Roja film achieved the **National award for best lyricist and best music director.**
 
• **Lagaan** was selected for the** Best Foreign Language Film at the 74th Academy Awards**, becoming the third Indian film to be selected.
